title: Reimagining Sharing Economy via Helium Blockchain
text:
Reimagining the Sharing Economy through Blockchain: Helium Decentralized Wireless Network.
Helium uses Proof of Coverage (PoC) consensus for IoT hotspot validation.
Security vulnerabilities identified:
- Sybil attacks: fake hotspots submitting false coverage proofs
- GPS spoofing: manipulating location data to fake coverage
- Oracle price manipulation: attacking HNT/USD price feeds
- Hotspot firmware vulnerabilities: remote code execution risks
- Eclipse attacks on peer discovery
- Coverage gaming: coordinated fake witness attacks
- Network congestion via spam challenges
Mitigation: cryptographic coverage proofs, geographic verification, stake slashing.
Source: ResearchGate 388772635
